subject: 🔑 Room assignment confirmed - $building_name, Room $room_number
body:
Dear $recipient_name,

$intro_line

=== THE ROOM ===
Building: $building_name
Room Number: $room_number
Floor Number: $floor_number
Room Type: $room_type
Building Address: $building_address
Campus: $campus_location

=== WHO IS LIVING HERE ===
$occupant_list

Current occupancy: $current_occupants of $max_occupants

=== THE NEW ASSIGNMENT ===
Student Assigned: $student_name ($student_id)
Assignment Reference: $assignment_id
Contract Number: $contract_number
Monthly Rent: £$monthly_rent
Move-In Date: $move_in_date
Planned Move-Out Date: $move_out_date
Assigned By: $assigned_by
Assigned On: $assigned_date

=== WHAT YOU NEED TO DO ===

1. COLLECT YOUR KEY
   - New residents should visit the Housing Office to collect a key or access card before moving in.

2. COMPLETE THE INVENTORY CHECKLIST
   - Complete the move-in inventory checklist within 7 days of arriving so you are not held responsible for any pre-existing damage.

3. SHARED SPACES
   - Please agree how you will share the kitchen, bathroom and communal areas, and keep them clean and clear.
   - Quiet hours are 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM.

=== IF SOMETHING IS WRONG ===
If this assignment is not what you expected, or your room does not meet an accessibility, medical or other agreed requirement, contact the Housing Office straight away.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Housing Office: housing@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Best regards,
University Housing Administration

$signature

intro_line.default: There has been a change to the room you are living in.
